fusions.name: Cold Thud
fusions.desc: You drop onto the ground and deal 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning each for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil Drop
fusions.desc: A plunging pounce that deals 30 damage, up to 2 times at maximum range, and ignores the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Unbending Moment
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Hardened by Blows
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (46% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour is also 6% higher at all times.
